Screen checkConfirm in Vanderbilt's Oracle or UKG during a recorded demo: approval chains by transaction type; who enters costing in each area; the name of the team that processes moves from a requisition.

1 · Intro

When to use it.

Many pay problems are handoff problems: each person assumed someone else had it. This course shows, for each transaction, what you do, who else acts, and what happens next.

It is a draft. Approval chains by transaction type are not confirmed yet, so those cells say To confirm.

Use this whenYou are not sure whether a step is yours, who acts after you, or who to go to when something is wrong.

2 · Walk through

How the work is split.

Check off each item as you read.

Who owns what, by transaction (draft)
The workYour partWho else actsWhat happens next
Create a positionYou.To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.Once approved, the position can go on a requisition. The hire inherits from it.
Update a position (including a reclassification)You.To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.Position changes never reach an existing requisition. Update the incumbent's assignment yourself.
Create a requisitionYou.More than one opening also goes to central finance. To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.Recruiting works the requisition. The recruiter makes the offer.
Convert a pending worker (hire)You, after the clear to start email.Your business unit approver.Payroll pays what the record says. A missing element or a wrong conversion means a wrong first paycheck.
Change AssignmentYou.To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.Payroll pays from the approved assignment.
Change working hoursYou.To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.Payroll pays the new salary from the effective date.
Promote (no requisition)You, when there is no requisition.To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.Payroll pays the new salary from the effective date.
Transfer or promotion without a requisitionYou.To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.You review costing in the new area. Payroll pays from the approved assignment.
Add an assignment (second job)You.To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.Each assignment has its own costing, hours, and pay.
Change salaryYou.Many departmental finance approvers review these. To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.Payroll picks up the approved salary in the payroll period it falls in. A backdated change pays later as retro.
Add a staff supplementYou.To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.It pays every payroll until it ends. Someone has to end an ongoing supplement.
Add a one-time payment (such as a sign-on bonus)You. For a new hire, the recruiter normally adds it to the offer.To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.It pays with the regular paycheck for that month.
Grossed-up additional compensation (net payment)You.To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.Oracle works out the gross. Pay goes to direct deposit.
Request an off-cycle paymentYou: the Oracle transaction and the form.Payroll decides whether the request qualifies.Payroll runs the payment and you tell the employee when to expect it.
Approve a time cardThe employee approves their own time card first.The manager approves. Payroll signs off.Payroll pays the approved hours.
Enter PTO on a time cardYou, when the employee can't enter it.The manager approves the time card. Payroll signs off.Payroll pays the PTO hours with the time card.
Voluntary terminationYou.To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.The termination stops pay and Oracle notifies payroll. Do not send a separate payroll request.
Involuntary termination (misconduct)You, after your PCB consultant and leadership agree.To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.The termination stops pay and Oracle notifies payroll.
Reduction in forceYou.To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.Regular pay runs to the termination date. Separation pay set by the agreement is paid separately.
Termination with more than one assignmentYou, with the other assignment's HCM.To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.Terminate Employment stops pay for every job. End Assignment stops only yours.
Enter costing for a personYou or your finance partner. Confirm who owns it in your department.To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.Oracle uses the costing in effect on the Pay Period End Date and does not prorate.
Change existing costingYou or your finance partner. Confirm who owns it in your department.To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.Costing results post to the General Ledger after payroll runs.
FMLA or TMLA absenceYou. To confirm: who enters intermittent occurrences.To confirm: the approval routing for each absence type.To confirm: how the leave reaches pay.
Student and faculty assignment changesYou. From a requisition, PCB Internal Talent Acquisition processes it.To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.An assignment left open past term end keeps the person active and payable.
Job code and level for a roleCompensation picks the job. You do not.Compensation, through the pre-search or reclass memo.None.
Exempt or non-exempt statusDo not decide it yourself.Compensation.Payroll pays by the status on the record.
Background checkYou set it up on the requisition and wait for clearance.The background check team clears the hire.None.
Transfer or promotion from a requisitionNot you. Never create a direct hire for someone already in process.Recruiting sends it to central HR, which processes it.Payroll pays from the approved assignment.
Weekly time card checkYou, every week. You chase managers for missing or late time cards.Employees and managers approve.Payroll signs off, then runs payroll.
A pay errorYou bring the facts: what was expected, what was paid, what the record shows.The manager helps with time card facts.Payroll decides how and when to correct it, including any off-cycle payment.
Running payrollNever you. Do not try to run or rerun payroll.None.Payroll.

Watch-outs

  • Never try to run or rerun payroll yourself.
  • Never create a direct hire for someone already in a recruiting process.
  • Open item: approval chains by transaction type are not confirmed. The owners will fill in the cells that say To confirm.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

3 · Knowledge check

Check your understanding.

Three questions. You get feedback on each answer. All three right completes the course.

Q1An employee's paycheck was short. What is your part?

Q2A promotion came from a posted requisition. Who processes it?

Q3Who decides whether a role is exempt or non-exempt?

Keep it handy.

HCM Academy job aid · Start Here

Who owns what: your part, by transaction

Use when: You are not sure whether a step is yours, who acts after you, or who to go to when something is wrong. · System: Overview

  1. You own the record.
  2. Compensation owns the job behind the pay.
  3. Recruiting and central HR own moves that come from a requisition.
  4. Employees and managers own the hours.
  5. Finance partners own the funding.
  6. Payroll owns the payroll run and every correction.
  7. Track your transaction until it is approved.
